items.title: BoE rate peak of 4.25% ‘will not be enough’, NIESR says in Autumn 2026 outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- The Bank of England needs to raise interest rates beyond the 4.25% peak forecast for next year because inflation is expected to peak at 4.4% in February 2027, up from 3.8% in July, British think tank National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR) said in its Autumn 2026 Economic Outlook.
